WebP 转换：全部可用目标WebP conversions: every available target

WebP 是浏览器原生支持的现代图片格式，可以是无损也可以是有损，还可能是多帧动画。这份工具能把它当作源：解码成画布后转成 PNG / JPEG / PDF；但写进文档的路线只嵌入原始字节，接收方能不能显示取决于那个工具。WebP is a modern image format the browser handles natively; it can be lossless or lossy, and it can carry several frames. This tool uses it as a source — decoded onto a canvas for PNG, JPEG or PDF — while document routes embed the original bytes, leaving display support to the receiving tool.

这个来源格式的共同限制What holds for every target from this source

  • 没有 OCR；图片到 TXT、CSV、JSON、Excel 的组合被置灰并说明No OCR; image to TXT, CSV, JSON and Excel are greyed out with a reason
  • 转 PNG 是无损封装，不会恢复有损 WebP 已经丢掉的细节PNG is a lossless container and does not restore detail a lossy WebP already lost
  • 多帧 WebP 会按单帧处理；动画与后续帧不保留（本轮不做动图输入）A multi-frame WebP is treated as one frame; the animation and later frames are not kept (animated input is out of scope this round)
  • 文档路线嵌入原始 WebP 字节，Word 与多数 Markdown 阅读器对它的支持并不一致Document routes embed the original WebP bytes, and support in Word and most Markdown readers is inconsistent

常见问题Questions people actually ask

WebP 转 PNG 会更大吗？Will WebP to PNG be larger?

通常会。PNG 是无损容器，WebP 的压缩优势在这里消失；若原图很大，输出可能显著变大。需要体积时请转 JPEG，或保留 WebP。Usually yes. PNG is a lossless container, so WebP’s compression advantage disappears and a large source can produce a much larger file. For size, choose JPEG or keep the WebP.

能转多帧 WebP 动画吗？Can an animated WebP be converted?

只会取一帧。当前版本没有把多帧 WebP 当作动画输入，也不提供丢帧披露；需要保留动画时请留在 WebP。Only one frame is taken. This version does not treat multi-frame WebP as animated input and gives no frame-loss disclosure; keep it as WebP to preserve the animation.

WebP 放进 Word 会显示吗？Will a WebP display inside Word?

取决于 Word 的版本与平台。转换器按原始字节嵌入，不转码；要保证显示，先转成 PNG 或 JPEG 再写入文档。It depends on the Word version and platform. The converter embeds the original bytes without transcoding; to guarantee display, convert to PNG or JPEG before building the document.

转 PDF 的页面尺寸怎么定？How is the PDF page size decided?

取图片自身的宽高（按 96 DPI 换算成点），整张图铺满一页，透明处铺白；不是 A4，也不裁切。From the image’s own dimensions at 96 DPI: the picture fills one page with transparency filled white. It is not A4 and nothing is cropped.

不需要账号，也不需要联网：装好扩展后点图标，在新标签页里打开工作台，文件从磁盘直接选。No account and no network: install the extension, click its icon, and the workbench opens in a new tab reading straight off your disk.
